questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The fact that it was an english speaking country and that the university's Philosophy department is renowned.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: The St Andrews team were very helpful in communicating relevant information, but I was unsure what was expected of me by the University of Copenhagen - whether I needed to register my arrival and fill out any online form or not

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Emails with information, online info sessions before arrival and in person info session upon arrival

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: A number of different dorms

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Full catering - they were able to accommodate te most if not all dietary requirements

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: It is very easy to find/get housing - though most students living in uni dorms are quite young compared to most exchange students, I was very happy with my housing situation
